summary.title: Part 02 — 12 February 1892 & 1898: The Porcelain Filter & Martinus Beijerinck's 'Contagious Living Fluid' (Virus)

plates.quality_reason: Quality: readable faces (Russian botanist Dmitri Ivanovsky on 12 February 1892 pouring mottled tobacco sap through a Chamberland porcelain filter candle, dissolving to Dutch microbiologist Martinus Beijerinck in 1898 proving serial replication in living leaves and coining 'contagium vivum fluidum' ('virus'), and Félix d'Hérelle in September 1917 discovering bacteria-eating bacteriophages).
